description: A UC Merced robotics society team.
summary: Our project applies satellite data and predicts forecasting for the location you choose. This is done to develop relevant and up-to-date insights and planting strategies for your specific and/or planned location.
details: As farming becomes harder, as the droughts become more and more frequent under a constantly changing climate, we have come up with a solution for farmers to have easy access to navigating tools. Our tool analyzes the most recent measurements and future predictions for factors including sunlight, rain and soil moisture, soil and air temperature to determine if any of them could cause issues for the crops.
